🔻The weak business updates for the December quarter dampened market sentiment

Adding to the market jitters was the detection of five flu-like HMPV cases in Karnataka and Gujarat, despite government assurances that there's no need to panic.

🔻The weak business updates for the December quarter dampened market sentiment and triggered a selloff in banking
